status: first prospective candidate; not the final basketball model
lineage: P1 ladder rung L2 = hoopslab.models.baselines.PlayerMean(half_life=5.0), selected on prior seasons in every development season (docs/p1/01_ladder_report.md section 3.4); mode A results: core CRPS skill vs L0 +27.15%
forecast_mode: A - CONDITIONAL ON APPEARANCE: every distribution is P(stat | the player appears); no appearance probability is produced or implied
forecast_time: scheduled tip - 60 min (information cutoff); forecast created at or after the cutoff and before the tip

pmf_construction.MIN: normal(mu = exponentially weighted mean of past minutes over appearances, half-life 5 appearances; sd = 6) discretised to integer minutes 0..70 (bins k-0.5..k+0.5, open ends)
pmf_construction.counts: negative binomial(mean = exponentially weighted per-appearance mean, half-life 5; dispersion r per target fitted by method of moments on all visible appearances, clipped to [1.5, 500]) over 0..k_max, tail mass folded into the top bin
pmf_construction.unknown_player: league pmf of the target over all visible appearances (+0.01 smoothing) when the player has no visible appearance

fitting_at_forecast_time: refit on every forecast from the supplied history: per-player exponentially weighted means over appearances (seconds > 0), league negative-binomial dispersion per target, league pmf fallback

required_inputs.history_policy: league-wide completed player-games with knowledge_time <= cutoff, from the executor's history start (the P1 reference history starts 1997-10-01; the league pmf fallback and the negative-binomial dispersion are fitted on everything supplied, so the history start is part of data_snapshot_id)

fields: game{game_id, league, season_id, phase, scheduled_tip, home_team_id, away_team_id, status_at_cutoff}
model{version, half_life_appearances, mode, targets, implementation_hash, pmf_construction, dispersion_r_fitted, league_appearances_in_history}

players[{player_id, team_id, availability_state, status_source, status_time, history_appearances, history_fallback, distributions{target: {pmf, support, mean, median, p10, p25, p50, p75, p90, threshold_probabilities}}}]
output_schema.lock: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON (sorted keys, no whitespace) of every field except lock_hash

governance.no_retuning: half-life, pmf shapes, dispersion fit and targets are frozen; a change is a new model version
